nodes.description: Public mapping storing token balances; mutated by transferFrom, distribute and list.
Nested mapping of owner-to-spender allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constant token decimals (18).
Total token supply initialized to 1e31.
Token name BABEL.
Token symbol BabelFish.
UniswapV2-compatible router address used by list().
WETH address used to derive the pair in the constructor.
Privileged owner address set from tx.origin in the constructor.
External Ferrum bot-protection contract called via low-level call.
Derived Uniswap pair address passed to the bot-protection call.
Sets owner from tx.origin, derives uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
Payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender.
Payable transfer guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked balance and allowance updates.
Payable approval that writes the caller's allowance mapping.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to an external address.
Internal pure function computing a Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash.
Owner-only batch overwrite of balances and external bot-protection call.
Owner-only listing function adding liquidity with a block.timestamp deadline.
Caller-controlled address used in transfer, transferFrom, approve and owner checks.
Origin address assigned to owner and given infinite allowance in the constructor.
Timestamp used to build the liquidity deadline in list().
Arbitrary delegatecall executed on an attacker-supplied address in delegate().
Low-level external call with abi.encodeWithSelector to the bot-protection contract.
External payable call to the router in list() forwarding msg.value.
Unchecked += / -= arithmetic on balances and allowances (Solidity 0.7, no SafeMath).

edges.reason: _from parameter is consumed by transferFrom balance and allowance logic.
_to parameter is consumed by transferFrom recipient balance update.
_value parameter flows into allowance and balance arithmetic.
_spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by approve.
Address parameter a is the delegatecall target.
Bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
amount parameter is written into recipient balances in distribute.
_tos array determines recipients in distribute.
_numList sets liquidity token amounts in list.
_amounts array sets recipient balances in list.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _from and used to decrement allowance.
approve writes allowance for the caller-controlled msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, a caller-dependent authorization check.
distribute requires msg.sender == owner before minting balances.
list requires msg.sender == owner before adding liquidity.
owner is assigned directly from tx.origin in the constructor.
tx.origin receives a supply share and is granted an infinite uniPair allowance.
block.timestamp determines the router deadline, enabling timestamp dependency.
Timestamp-derived deadline is passed into addLiquidityETH.
delegate() executes delegatecall on a caller-supplied target and payload.
checkBots modifier performs an external call to botProtection before state updates.
distribute performs an unguarded external call to botProtection before the balance loop.
list makes an external payable router call while balances are already mutated.
Untracked += / -= on balanceOf and allowance without SafeMath in Solidity 0.7.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 and writes balances without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf mapping entries.
transferFrom consumes and decrements the allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
list uses totalSupply to compute the owner share.
list calls addLiquidityETH on the pancakeRouter state variable.
delegate is restricted by owner state variable comparison.
distribute is restricted by owner state variable comparison.
list is restricted by owner state variable comparison.
checkBots modifier calls the botProtection contract from transferFrom.
distribute invokes botProtection directly via low-level call.
uniPair state variable is passed into the bot-protection call arguments.
wrappedEther is used in the constructor to derive the pair address.
Constructor invokes pairOfTokens to compute uniPair.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
Constructor assigns tx.origin into the owner state variable.
Constructor stores the derived pair address into uniPair.
Constructor sets unlimited allowances for the router and tx.origin.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom's dataflow.
_to is a transient parameter consumed by transferFrom's balance update.
_value is a transient parameter consumed by transferFrom's arithmetic.
_spender is a transient parameter written into allowance by approve.
a is a transient parameter used as the delegatecall target.
b is a transient parameter used as the delegatecall payload.
amount is a transient parameter assigned into balances by distribute.
_tos is a transient recipient array consumed by distribute and list loops.
_numList is a transient parameter used for liquidity and bot balance in list.
_amounts is a transient array assigned into balances by list.
i is a transient loop counter confined to the distribute/list balance loops.
